newsitem.title: USA: Hess Q2 set to be above initial estimates.
newsitem.headline: Hess Q2 set to be above initial estimates.

text.p: Some analysts are raising their second quarter earnings forecasts for Amerada Hess Corp after the company said that it will take a charge on its North Sea exploration operations in the third quarter rather than the second, analysts say.
"The company indicated that it would take a $15 million charge in the third quarter rather than the second," an analyst said.
Although the First Call number is for earnings per share is for $0.20 per share, the analyst range is from zero to $0.45.
"The problem of Hess' first in/first out (FIFO) accounting method is that it makes the company difficult to judge, depending on when they closed their book," said the analyst.
No one at the company was available for comment. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
